name: @lastcoinvision/ui-tokens
description: Framework-agnostic LCV brand tokens (colors, type scale, spacing) shared across web/, the desktop app, and the mobile app. Colors are ported from web/tailwind.config.ts — that file remains the source of truth for the marketing site's own Tailwind build; this package is for consumers that aren't Tailwind (React Native, Tauri's non-Tailwind chrome, etc).
